texts.preamble: Jagdish Kumar vs Ut Of Chandigarh Thr Food Inspector on 13 November, 2017 Author: Kuldip Singh Bench: Kuldip Singh 231 In The High Court Of Punjab And Haryana At Chandigarh Crr No.3540 of 2012 (O&M) Date of decision : November 13, 2017 Jagdish Kumar ....... Petitioner Versus State (Chandigarh Administration, Chandigarh) ....... Respondent Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kuldip Singh Present:- Mr. J.S. Lalli, Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Amit Kumar Goel, App for U.T., Chandigarh.
texts.facts: The allegations against the petitioner are that he was found in possession of 450 Kg. of khoya for public sale, which was wrapped in polythene packets of about 10 Kg. each.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that there is violation of Clause (m) of Section 2 of the Act and that the contents were not found injurious to health.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that there is violation of Clause (m) of Section 2 of the Act and that the contents were not found injurious to health.
